svg.title: Building attention one step at a time
svg.desc: A four-stage roadmap: simplified attention, learned query/key/value projections, our current batched causal head with dropout, and multi-head attention as the next reading step.

g.text: Building attention one step at a time
Use input vectors to compare positions and mix information.
Learn W_Q, W_K, W_V; compute scores, weights, and contexts.
One set of projections is shared across input positions.
Add the causal mask and attention-weight dropout.
Input [B, T, d_in] → contexts [B, T, d_out]; still one head.
Compute several attention mixtures and combine their outputs.
Multiple heads within a block; blocks form a sequence.
Each stage builds on the previous one. No optimizer update is shown here.
